title: Finite projective coordinate reindexing preserves the twisting module
statement: Let $S$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], and $\beta$ a finite nonempty coordinate type. For projective space with its base-change integral-model convention [def-pc-proj] and twisting module [def-pc-projective-space-twist], there are $n\ge0$ and a scheme isomorphism $e:\mathbb P(\beta;S)\cong\mathbb P(\operatorname{ULift}(\operatorname{Fin}(n+1));S)$ over $S$ such that $e^*\mathcal O(1)\cong\mathcal O(1)$ [def-pc-module-pullback].

source.place: Constructions Definition 01NF and Lemma 01NE: projective-space charts and coordinate construction, applied to bijective renaming and its inverse.

proof.text: Equip beta with Fintype.ofFinite. Since beta is nonempty, Fintype.card_pos and Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero give card beta = n+1. Compose Equiv.ulift with the inverse of Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq to obtain b : ULift (Fin (n+1)) equiv beta.

Use the native construction homOfIsFreeGenerator with the reordered coordinate sections of the identity pullback of O(1), on the reordered standard opens. The native isFreeGenerator_pullbackSection_twistOneSection provides its local free generators, while Equiv.iSup_comp and iSup_standardOpen prove its cover condition. The construction homOfIsFreeGenerator_over proves compatibility with the base. Apply the coordinate-reindexing invertibility statement to get the scheme isomorphism asIso phi.

The native twistRestrictHom is already an isomorphism from phi pullback O(1) to the identity pullback of O(1). Compose asIso twistRestrictHom with the component of Scheme.Modules.pullbackId at O(1). This supplies the required twisting-module isomorphism. No new module-gluing theorem is needed.
